	decision_category = economy_decisions
	image = "gfx/interface/icons/trade_goods/illustrations/icon_goods_steel.dds"

	potential = {
		tsin_company_count > 0
	}

	allow = {
		always = yes
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		value = 0
	}

	option = {
		name = tsin_dissolve_companies_decision.a
		ai_chance = { value = 100 }
		effect = {
			if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = tsin_company_steel } remove_country_modifier = tsin_company_steel }
			if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = tsin_company_machinery } remove_country_modifier = tsin_company_machinery }
			if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = tsin_company_textile } remove_country_modifier = tsin_company_textile }
			if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = tsin_company_chemical } remove_country_modifier = tsin_company_chemical }
			if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = tsin_company_railway } remove_country_modifier = tsin_company_railway }
		}
	}
